one_line: AI models launch, industry adoption grows, benchmarks evolve, and AI helps fix web security.

themes.title: New multimodal and agent models released
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 model, announced the Voxtral 3 voice SDK, and Anthropic released the Claude Duet agent. OpenAI also announced that its GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models will be available on Google Cloud for enterprise customers.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: AI expands into industry applications
themes.text: DeepSeek secured roughly $15 billion in funding, while Walmart introduced an Agent Gateway for shopper AI agents. Google added Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay, Karta AI raised a seed round for banking call automation, and NVIDIA’s open models were adopted across European public‑sector, weather, and retail projects. Mistral partnered with Mozilla to power Firefox’s Smart Window browsing assistant.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
Google adds conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay in US
Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: Benchmarks and frameworks advance evaluation
themes.text: Researchers evaluated frontier AI models on the LIBERO‑10 robot suite, introduced the PAPAV framework for multimodal agents, and released the Environment Duels benchmark to study LLM co‑evolution. Microsoft researchers also used a human‑directed AI process to prove the KLS conjecture in high‑dimensional geometry.

stories.headline: Frontier AI models evaluated on LIBERO-10 robot tasks, GPT‑6 Astra tops at 44% success
Paper proposes PAPAV framework to unify multimodal agents and robots
Environment Duels benchmark studies LLM co‑evolution through author‑solver interactions
Microsoft researchers prove 31-year-old KLS conjecture in high-dimensional geometry

themes.title: AI tools uncover critical web vulnerabilities
themes.text: OpenAI and Google’s Wiz AI systems identified two critical PHP vulnerabilities that could affect up to 70 % of websites, prompting patches from the PHP Foundation.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
